args.body:
• Spot freight rates fell 9% this quarter while contract rates held steady, creating a widening gap between spot and contract pricing.
• Fuel surcharges now track weekly diesel prices, adding near-term volatility to freight cost forecasts.
• Shippers who split volume across three carriers paid the least, per the companion piece — carrier diversification is the key cost lever.
args.title: Freight Pricing Summary — Juniper Blog + Companion
